conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Compliance Division. This is Agent Martin speaking. How may I assist you today?
Hello, um, I got a message on my phone about back taxes and something about my account being under review. I'm very worried.

Yes, I see your file here. It appears there is a significant issue with your federal tax filings from 2019 through 2021. The IRS has detected discrepancies and unpaid taxes that must be resolved immediately.
Oh dear, I don't understand. I always pay my taxes. Is this going to affect my Social Security?

Unfortunately, yes. Since you have not responded to the certified letters we sent, your benefits may be at risk. There's now a penalty, accumulated interest, and legal costs added to your outstanding balance.
But I never got any letters. What is the balance? I can't lose my Social Security, I need it for my rent and medicine.

The total outstanding balance, as of today, is $7,520.44. If you do not act quickly, the IRS will proceed with placing a lien on your property and freezing your bank accounts. This could impact your ability to access any government benefits.
No, please, I can't have my accounts frozen. What am I supposed to do? I don't have that kind of money.

I understand this is stressful, but the IRS follows strict federal guidelines. Unless the balance is settled today, your case will be handed to the legal division for criminal prosecution. That could mean wage garnishment, asset seizure, and even arrest.
I, I can't go to jail. I'm 74 years old. Isn't there a way to fix this?

Because you called voluntarily, I can put a temporary hold on your file. However, you must make a payment right now to avoid legal escalation. Are you able to access your bank or any payment method immediately?
I only have a little in my checking account, and a small retirement. I don't use the computer much. I have a debit card, I think.
We can accept payment via debit card, wire transfer, or approved prepaid gift cards. If you can't pay the full amount, we can work with a partial payment to stop further action.
I could maybe get a few hundred dollars from the bank. I don't know how to do a wire transfer.

That's alright. The most straightforward option is to purchase prepaid cards, Target, Best Buy, or Apple gift cards. These are accepted by the IRS for urgent settlements. How soon can you get to the store?
I suppose I could go in the next hour or so. I can try to get a ride.
Good. I need you to stay on the line with me the entire time. Do not discuss this with anyone, IRS investigations are confidential. If anyone asks, simply say it's for a personal purchase.
Alright, but I'm really scared. You're sure this will stop them from taking my money?
As long as you cooperate and provide the gift card codes today, I will submit a report to halt legal actions. If you hang up or speak to anyone, the case will automatically escalate.
Okay, I'll go now. How much should I put on the cards?
Purchase as much as you are able, up to $1,000 per card is allowed. Bring back as many as you can, and I will walk you through the next steps.
Alright, I'm leaving now. Please don't let them freeze my account.
